rows.issue: Three earlier NFL sessions recorded player props as blocked; they are not.
rows.detail: nfl.com/players/<slug>/stats/logs/ publishes per-game logs and they reconcile to season totals (IC-15, IC-16).

rows.issue: Week 10 injury page still shows pre-game records (WAS 3-5-1, NYG 5-3-1).
rows.detail: The Thursday game finished 24-21 on 2026-11-12; live standings show WAS 3-5-1 / NYG 5-3-1 including it. The injury page was not refreshed after the game.

rows.issue: Published passing AVG does not reproduce yds/att on 4 of 32 rows.
rows.detail: JAX 8.6 vs 8.546, KC 7.8 vs 7.745, PIT 6.4 vs 6.452, SEA 7.2 vs 7.253 - both directions, so it is not a rounding rule. The published column is recorded but never used; the site publishes its own yds/att (IC-07).

rows.issue: No official depth chart exists, so 2nd/3rd/4th-string replacement is not derivable.
rows.detail: The club depth-chart URL returns 404; the roster page carries no depth rank. Availability is published by position, never as a starter/backup label.

rows.issue: The historical archive is third-party and its licence was not reviewed.
rows.detail: 7,548 games with closing spread and total; used for research only.

rows.issue: No market price exists for 2026, so every market cell is blank.
rows.detail: The NFL publishes no lines; no licensed price archive is in scope.

rows.issue: Home-field advantage carries a 0.85 haircut that is a judgement call.
rows.detail: Measured 2017-2025 home margin, then multiplied by 0.85 to shrink toward published ranges. The raw value and the used value are both published.

rows.issue: Player-level correlations rest on 3-8 official games each.
rows.detail: Sample sizes are printed next to every r. Nothing is claimed beyond those samples.

rows.issue: A.J. Brown's season receiving total is not published on any page read.
rows.detail: He is outside the top-25 leaderboard, so his season columns are blank and only his game log is published (IC-16).

rows.issue: The row-level identity of the 15-value team passing table is partially proven.
rows.detail: Columns 1-8 and 14-15 are proven by arithmetic; columns 9-13 (first downs, 20+, 40+, long) are omitted rather than guessed.

rows.issue: R-01: a root dashboard rebuild deletes peer NFL navigation.
rows.detail: Reproduced 2026-11-13 on 553c3f0: 14 files lose the nfl-lines nav block.

rows.issue: Break-even rates assume -110 on every leg.
rows.detail: 51.35% for two-leg, 52.38%... every threshold here moves with the price.

rows.issue: No strategy has passed G12 (prospective replication).
rows.detail: Backtest-only evidence cannot exclude luck; see luck.json L4.
